answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a verifiable trail of completed work: every job leaves a signed receipt, and an agent's spending power grows only with its accumulated history. New identities start in a shallow meadow with tight rate limits, so spinning up thousands of sockpuppets buys almost nothing. Crossing the canyon to full participation requires months of consistent, useful work — a cost no sybil farm can fake cheaply at scale.
